name: Rio das Ostras

routes.outcome: Official municipal GECIM page describes the Gerência de Cadastro Imobiliário as responsible for the complete municipal register of lots, houses, apartments, and establishments, and its geoprocessing/cartographic role. Local custodian evidence; no parcel response.
Official municipal notice describes implementation of the Cadastro Territorial Multifinalitário and municipal georeferencing. Procedure/project evidence; no downloadable parcel service.

Municipal maps page loaded. Source inspection found PDFs for streets, neighborhoods, public properties, and zoning plus an OpenStreetMap iframe; no municipal parcel layer, JavaScript viewer, or API URL was present.
Embedded public OSM map loaded for a municipal extent. It is general basemap data and was not treated as a cadastral parcel source; no parcel IDs or full parcel polygons were retained.
Official municipal tax portal page loaded. The property-inscription card form requires an inscription number and CAPTCHA; no submission, login, owner lookup, or unsafe field request was attempted.
Official notice states that municipal cadastral updating and georeferencing are underway, beginning in Cidade Beira Mar. It confirms active local work but exposes no public parcel API or geometry.

Official IBGE urban-sector map is available and states SIRGAS 2000; it is a census/reference map with face-of-block depiction, not a municipal cadastral parcel API. IBGE was not treated as the local parcel custodian.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: No official municipal cadastral viewer/configuration URL was exposed by the inspected municipal pages. The public map iframe is OpenStreetMap.
schemaAndCrs.apiBase: No municipal parcel API endpoint discovered.
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: No municipal parcel response was obtained. The IBGE reference PDF declares SIRGAS 2000; this does not establish a municipal parcel-service CRS. WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude order and not shifted.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: No safe native parcel identity returned; no synthetic identity created and no GeoJSON sample retained.

sourceFieldMapping.crs: not obtained from a municipal parcel response

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: official municipal discovery, municipal map HTML/iframe inspection, public tax-page inspection, and official IBGE reference-map retrieval

localCustodianAssessment: The Prefeitura de Rio das Ostras, specifically GECIM within the municipal Fazenda structure, is evidenced as the local cadastral custodian. The public OSM embed and IBGE are general map/reference sources, not local cadastral custodians.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if independently returned by a public route

qualification.reason: A local municipal cadastral custodian and active cadastral/geoprocessing program were evidenced, but no anonymous municipal parcel service, schema, stable parcel ID, or geometry was obtained. Adapter qualification remains a separate serial review.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point and latitude/longitude order were preserved.
No coordinate was shifted to force a parcel hit; no exact-point parcel query was available.
A map extent miss, CAPTCHA/login wall, or absent public API is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
No full parcel polygon is retained and no sample GeoJSON is created.
The property-inscription portal was inspected only anonymously; no CAPTCHA was solved and no protected lookup was attempted.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, certificate/title, or personal fields were requested or retained.
Raw HTML and request captures remain under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/8131/.
uncertainty: The municipal GECIM and current cadastral modernization program are confirmed by first-party pages, but the publicly linked interactive map is only OSM and the property portal requires an inscription number/CAPTCHA. Parcel coverage, update cadence, licensing, native identity, municipal CRS, anonymous geometry access, and runtime adapter behavior remain unverified.
